hooks.name: tests-on-save
hooks.description: Runs node scripts/hooks/tests-on-save.mjs after the agent saves a .ts or .mjs file. For files under skeleton/, apps/<name>/, tests/ or scripts/ it runs the related Vitest tests with fast property tests (WRAITH_PBT_RUNS=20) and sends failures back to the agent. It blocks nothing; a save cannot be blocked.
